title: Hybrid-Policy Self-Editing for Composable Unstructured Knowledge Editing
abstract: arXiv:2608.11660v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance across natural language tasks, yet they are trained on static corpora and their knowledge quickly becomes outdated in a fast-changing world. This motivates knowledge editing (KE), which updates specific knowledge in an LLM without changing unrelated others. Recent works move from structured knowledge triples toward unstructured KE (UKE), where the edit is a free-form passage that may state multiple facts at once. Nonetheless, existing editors inject such a passage yet fail to use it: the edited model can recall the passage, but can neither answer atomic questions about its facts nor compose them into multi-hop reasoning. We attribute this missing property, which we term composability, to editors' passive reliance on the fixed passage as the sole learning source. In response, we cast editing as a proactive self-distillation from a privileged in-context state of the same model,

translated_title: 混合策略自编辑用于可组合的无结构知识编辑
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在自然语言任务上表现出色，但它们基于静态语料库训练，在快速变化的世界中知识很快过时。这推动了知识编辑（KE）的发展，它更新LLM中的特定知识而不影响无关内容。近期工作从结构化知识三元组转向无结构知识编辑（UKE），其中编辑内容是一段自由文本，可能同时陈述多个事实。然而，现有编辑器注入此类段落却未能有效利用它：编辑后的模型能回忆段落，但无法回答关于其事实的原子性问题，也无法将它们组合成多跳推理。我们将这种缺失的属性称为可组合性，并将其归因于编辑器被动依赖固定段落作为唯一学习来源。为此，我们将编辑视为从同一模型的特权上下文状态进行的主动自蒸馏。
tldr: 本文提出一种混合策略自编辑方法，通过主动自蒸馏将无结构知识编辑中的固定段落转化为可组合的多跳推理能力，解决现有编辑器无法有效利用编辑内容的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid-policy self-editing method that proactively distills from a privileged in-context state to enable composable multi-hop reasoning in unstructured knowledge editing, addressing the failure of existing editors to utilize edited passages effectively.
